rubric_items.reason: All 16 known REQs (REQ-1..REQ-16) are traced by at least one story; no assumed or unknown REQs exist in the intent.
Most stories carry one outcome; S-5 bundles list label, detail label, list filter and the dashboard no-tile constraint, and S-7 mixes patient and doctor pages.
ACs are Given/When/Then with a +/-1 minute pair around the 24h limit that fails start-of-day, end-time or next-local-day implementations; the exact 24h instant is untested and S-3 ACs are generic.
The only limit is 24h after start time from REQ-2/A-02; dates and times are example instants with the 24h derivation stated inline.
Readable and consistent state names; S-7 title omits the doctor page its AC2 covers, and S-2 calls 09:59 the latest moment inside the day.

findings.text: S-7 is titled for the patient page only, but its AC2 checks the doctor page; the title does not describe the story's full scope.

cites.quote: ### S-7 Staff see Stale on the patient page
when staff open that doctor's page, then its upcoming appointments table lists the Scheduled one and not the Stale one, as before.

findings.suggested_fix: Retitle S-7 to cover patient and doctor pages, or move the doctor-page AC to its own story.

findings.text: S-2 says 09:59 on 4 December is the latest moment inside the day, but the day runs to 10:00 (24h after a 10:00 start); 09:59 is one minute before the limit, not its latest moment.

cites.quote: Each case acts at 09:59 on 4 December, the latest moment inside the day.

findings.suggested_fix: Say 'one minute before 24h after its start time', matching S-1 AC2 wording.

cites.quote: A Scheduled appointment that has not been marked Completed or `rescheduled` by 24h after its start time is marked Stale.
The appointment list is the page `/appointments`.
upcoming first (soonest first), then past (most recent first)
